text: We spend hours backing up thousands of family photos to the cloud, but we’re ignoring a massive accessibility blind spot. If you aren't adding metadata or descriptions, those digital memories remain invisible to anyone using a screen reader. A true backup isn't just about securing storage space; it's about ensuring usability. We need to prioritize alt text during the curation process so that our digital legacies are actually accessible to everyone, rather than just being a collection of silent files.
